requirements: R1: Fix the backend service so its health check endpoint successfully connects on port 18080
R2: Fix the backup container configuration so backup.sh correctly executes as a script instead of acting as a directory

slices.title: Fix backend health check and backup script execution
slices.jtbd: When implementing the initialization repairs for this epic, I want the backend and backup containers to start correctly, so that the environment runs without launch errors
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application environment is started, When the backup container initializes, Then the backup script executes without directory errors.
Given the backend container is running, When a request is made to the health endpoint on port 18080, Then it successfully connects and returns a healthy status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 failed container health checks on launch
